page.content:
Osaka street enforcer of the Kazama dojo line.

How Asuka Kazama connects

  • Faction: Kazama family — Asuka Kazama carries the Osaka Kazama dojo line.
  • Concept: Kazama-style traditional martial arts — Asuka uses the same Kazama-style art as Jun.

What is Asuka Kazama?

Asuka Kazama is a later Kazama relative, a hot-tempered Osaka fighter who enters the King of Iron Fist Tournament to drag family trouble — and Feng Wei — into the open.

Key threads lead to Kazama family and Kazama-style traditional martial arts.
